mapper.sql: select i.issue_id, i.issue_no, i.source_type, i.source_ref, i.title, i.description, i.problem_type, i.severity, i.found_date, i.found_dept, i.target_dept_id, i.target_person_id, i.deadline, i.status, i.warn_level, i.rectify_summary, i.close_time, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark, (select count(1) from jc_rectify_task t where t.issue_id = i.issue_id) as task_count, (select count(1) from jc_rectify_task t where t.issue_id = i.issue_id and t.status = '2') as task_done_count, case when i.deadline is null then null else datediff(i.deadline, curdate()) end as remain_days, d.dept_name as dept_name, p.name as person_name from jc_rectify_issue i left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.target_dept_id left join jc_person p on p.person_id = i.target_person_id
mapper.select: select max(issue_no) from jc_rectify_issue where issue_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.update: update jc_rectify_issue set warn_level = #{warnLevel} where issue_id = #{issueId}
update jc_rectify_issue set status = '1', close_time = null, warn_level = #{warnLevel}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where issue_id = #{issueId}
mapper.delete: update jc_rectify_issue set del_flag = '1' where issue_id = #{issueId}
mapper.select: where i.del_flag = '0' and i.status in ('0','1','2') and i.deadline is not null order by i.deadline asc

select count(1) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pending, sum(case when status in ('1','2') then 1 else 0 end) as rectifying, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as closed, sum(case when warn_level = '红灯' then 1 else 0 end) as overdue from jc_rectify_issue where del_flag = '0'
select avg(datediff(close_time, create_time)) from jc_rectify_issue where del_flag = '0' and status = '3' and close_time is not null
select count(1) from jc_rectify_review where review_type = '2'

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_rectify_issue i left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_rectify_source' and dd.dict_value = i.source_type where i.del_flag = '0' group by i.source_type, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_rectify_issue i left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_rectify_type' and dd.dict_value = i.problem_type where i.del_flag = '0' group by i.problem_type, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_rectify_issue i left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_rectify_severity' and dd.dict_value = i.severity where i.del_flag = '0' group by i.severity, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_rectify_issue i left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_rectify_status' and dd.dict_value = i.status where i.del_flag = '0' group by i.status, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select date_format(i.create_time, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value from jc_rectify_issue i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(i.create_time, '%Y-%m') order by name

select d.dept_name as name, count(1) as value from jc_rectify_issue i left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.target_dept_id where i.del_flag = '0' and i.create_time >= #{since} and i.target_dept_id is not null group by i.target_dept_id, d.dept_name order by value desc limit 10
